entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita and I had just concluded our..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita and I had just concluded our preparatory visit to Terador Air Force Base.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The city sustained heavy damage whe..."
entries.dialogueText: The city sustained heavy damage when Rizia reconquered it in the 1920s. Attempts had been made to revitalize it, but several bombed-out, derelict buildings still stood in its center.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She ordered our driver to stop in f..."
entries.dialogueText: She ordered our driver to stop in front of the tallest one. It was completely boarded up, and the remains of a fire escape dangled precariously from the fifth story.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is what you wanted me to see,..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is what you wanted me to see, isn't it? We took back this city, and we will take back the rest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pretty. But I'm not in the mood fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pretty. But I'm not in the mood for art."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus, can you go in and secure th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus, can you go in and secure the area?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gave me a scornful look."
entries.dialogueText: She gave me a scornful look.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You don't need Titus. You're with..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't need Titus. You're with me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the dimming light of the setting..."
entries.dialogueText: In the dimming light of the setting sun, I could just make out an old mural painted on its side -- an angular, 1920s-style depiction of a paleacci, defaced almost beyond recognition.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The mural's not important. Let's g..."
entries.dialogueText: "The mural's not important. Let's go in."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We won't be long. Come with me.""
entries.dialogueText: "We won't be long. Come with me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where are you taking me, Duchess A..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where are you taking me, Duchess Azaro?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Patience, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Patience, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She instructed my bodyguard to wait..."
entries.dialogueText: She instructed my bodyguard to wait in the car and led me up to the entrance. Drawing a key from her pocket, she unlocked the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Flickering lights illuminated the b..."
entries.dialogueText: Flickering lights illuminated the building's decrepit interior. We walked across the uneven concrete floor, stepping around shards of glass, until we came to an elevator shaft guarded by a man in a crisp blue jacket.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I noticed a brooch on his lapel sha..."
entries.dialogueText: I noticed a brooch on his lapel shaped like a pair of swords. He and Lucita exchanged nods as he let us into the elevator.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We ascended to what must have been..."
entries.dialogueText: We ascended to what must have been the very top floor. The elevator door opened, and we stepped out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Immediately, the atmosphere transfo..."
entries.dialogueText: Immediately, the atmosphere transformed. We were in a chic-looking lounge, its furnishings sleek and understated. The soft strains of jazz filled the air.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A handful of patrons were sitting a..."
entries.dialogueText: A handful of patrons were sitting around sipping cocktails. They paid us no mind as we crossed the room to a cozy private booth by the window.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where are we?""
entries.dialogueText: "Where are we?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What a brilliant idea. I'd love a..."
entries.dialogueText: "What a brilliant idea. I'd love a drink."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The guard here was wearing an Azar..."
entries.dialogueText: "The guard here was wearing an Azaro sigil..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That's what we're here for.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's what we're here for."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled ruefully."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled ruefully.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Of course he was. My family has us..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course he was. My family has used this place as a member's club since Rizia took back the Pales Administrative District."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""My family bought this building whe..."
entries.dialogueText: "My family bought this building when Rizia took back the Pales Administrative District. We've been using it as a member's club of sorts."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It was about time we went on that..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was about time we went on that date. And if we can't step out in public, we might as well come here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled ruefully."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled ruefully.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Until we're ready to go public, th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Until we're ready to go public, this is the closest we can get to a proper date."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I still find this ridiculous. I sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still find this ridiculous. I should be able to date my councilors if I want to."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is your father doing any better?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is your father doing any better?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Isn't this public? What if someone..."
entries.dialogueText: "Isn't this public? What if someone talks?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled conspiratorially."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled conspiratorially.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You looked like you could use a br..."
entries.dialogueText: "You looked like you could use a break from Ironjaw down there."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've got that right. Titus has b..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've got that right. Titus has barely let me out of his sights since Zille."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ironjaw?""
entries.dialogueText: "Ironjaw?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""His old boxing nickname. Didn't yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "His old boxing nickname. Didn't you follow his career before he joined the Golden Guard?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For your information, I like the m..."
entries.dialogueText: "For your information, I like the man. He's far more trustworthy than... some people I know."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You know my feelings about him. He..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know my feelings about him. He's up to something."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are wasting the King's time, D..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are wasting the King's time, Duchess. But since I'm here... one drink."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I don't know how you deal with it...."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know how you deal with it. My own guards are paid very handsomely to leave me alone."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""There's something about him that d..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's something about him that doesn't sit right with me. But I trust him if you do."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I don't want to live life stewing..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want to live life stewing over the opportunities I missed."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""This club takes its discretion pol..."
entries.dialogueText: "This club takes its discretion policy seriously, Your Majesty. Many of its guests would be in prison if it didn't."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Now that you mention it, I have go..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that you mention it, I have good news."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We had this conversation, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "We had this conversation, Your Majesty. It's even more important not to publicize our personal relationship now that we're at war."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We had this conversation, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "We had this conversation, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A bow-tied server approached our bo..."
entries.dialogueText: A bow-tied server approached our booth to take our orders. I took a look at the cocktail menu.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not many women would be so bold. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not many women would be so bold. I love that about you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll take a Palesian Sunset.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll take a Palesian Sunset."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll try the Terador Tea.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll try the Terador Tea."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Give me a Siegebreaker Sling.""
entries.dialogueText: "Give me a Siegebreaker Sling."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just sparkling water for me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just sparkling water for me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita nodded approvingly."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita nodded approvingly.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Sounds good. I'll have the same.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds good. I'll have the same."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita frowned, then shrugged."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita frowned, then shrugged.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""A beer for me, then. Whatever's on..."
entries.dialogueText: "A beer for me, then. Whatever's on tap."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The server bowed and left to fetch..."
entries.dialogueText: The server bowed and left to fetch our drinks.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "While we were waiting, Lucita gestu..."
entries.dialogueText: While we were waiting, Lucita gestured out the window. Beyond the twinkling lights of downtown Terador, a line of steadily flashing beacons marked the border wall between Rizia and Pales.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You're talking to Reinhart soon, a..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're talking to Reinhart soon, aren't you? There's no going back from that."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""There it is. The country that gave..."
entries.dialogueText: "There it is. The country that gave us so much grief."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""There it is. Our new business part..."
entries.dialogueText: "There it is. Our new business partner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You sound skeptical.""
entries.dialogueText: "You sound skeptical."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't believe our fathers wanted..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe our fathers wanted us to invade. Our current arrangement makes so much more sense."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Maybe it won't take a war for Pale..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe it won't take a war for Pales to reunite with Rizia. We can find an economic solution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am ready. Rizia is ready.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am ready. Rizia is ready."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have a bad feeling about it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I have a bad feeling about it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You sound like my father.""
entries.dialogueText: "You sound like my father."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The news of our impending war seem..."
entries.dialogueText: "The news of our impending war seemed to drastically speed up his recovery. I wouldn't be surprised if he's back on his feet by the time the war begins."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You know who doesn't? My father.""
entries.dialogueText: "You know who doesn't? My father."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I just hope we can get Vina back b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just hope we can get Vina back before it all goes to hell."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""No matter what, I'll see to her sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "No matter what, I'll see to her safe return. My father will, too."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Lord has seen fit to send us t..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Lord has seen fit to send us to war. He will oversee our swift victory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My father is finally getting his w..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father is finally getting his wish."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""So is mine.""
entries.dialogueText: "So is mine."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""So will General Taddeus Azaro.""
entries.dialogueText: "So will General Taddeus Azaro."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't believe we came so close t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe we came so close to war. It would've been a terrible mistake."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes, well...""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, well..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""For what it's worth, I do think we..."
entries.dialogueText: "For what it's worth, I do think we would have won. Our military's the strongest it's been in decades."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Given our lack of investment in th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given our lack of investment in the military, our showing would've been quite poor. Better to play it safe than risk losing even more of the country."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish I'd had the nerve to order..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I'd had the nerve to order an invasion. All that hassle and we didn't even get a share of the gas field."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope the gas from Aureus is wort..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope the gas from Aureus is worth everything we went through."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Ms. Werner seemed to think so.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ms. Werner seemed to think so."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you disappointed we didn't sta..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you disappointed we didn't start a war?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""What? No.""
entries.dialogueText: "What? No."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As long as Pales holds up its end..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as Pales holds up its end of the bargain."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I just hope Reinhart holds up his..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just hope Reinhart holds up his end of the bargain."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As long as Lespia is in the pictur..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as Lespia is in the picture, it won't be easy."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And even if the Palesians can be t..."
entries.dialogueText: "And even if the Palesians can be trusted, can Lespia?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not by choice. But it was either t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not by choice. But it was either this, or start a war."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes, well...""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, well..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's amazing news. I'm looking f..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's amazing news. I'm looking forward to working with the General again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's amazing news.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's amazing news."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That old dinosaur will be more of..."
entries.dialogueText: "That old dinosaur will be more of a hindrance than a help."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What a shame. I was looking forwar..."
entries.dialogueText: "What a shame. I was looking forward to watching you order our troops around."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She winked at me."
entries.dialogueText: She winked at me.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You'll still get plenty of that. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll still get plenty of that. But he'll be invaluable for behind-the-scenes strategizing."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I never wanted to end up in anothe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never wanted to end up in another war with Pales. But if we must fight, then I'm glad to have him with us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gave me an offended look."
entries.dialogueText: She gave me an offended look.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Without him, we'd be sitting in Pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Without him, we'd be sitting in Palesian territory right now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Bullshit, Lucita. I know you were..."
entries.dialogueText: "Bullshit, Lucita. I know you were behind the Pales border attack."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Shock and rage exploded on her face..."
entries.dialogueText: Shock and rage exploded on her face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just then, the server returned with..."
entries.dialogueText: Just then, the server returned with our drinks.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He carefully placed our Palesian Su..."
entries.dialogueText: He carefully placed our Palesian Sunsets on the table. They were garnished with tiny umbrellas.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He carefully placed our Siegebreake..."
entries.dialogueText: He carefully placed our Siegebreaker Slings on the table. They were garnished with maraschino cherries.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He carefully placed our Terador Tea..."
entries.dialogueText: He carefully placed our Terador Teas on the table. They were served in gold-plated mugs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He carefully placed my water and Lu..."
entries.dialogueText: He carefully placed my water and Lucita's beer on the table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita waited until he was gone to..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita waited until he was gone to speak.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're too beautiful to rot in pri..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're too beautiful to rot in prison."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want to go to war with you by my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to go to war with you by my side."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Because now I have you and your fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because now I have you and your family completely at my mercy. If I want something from you, you're going to give it to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""War with Pales was always going to..."
entries.dialogueText: "War with Pales was always going to be inevitable. If you didn't start something, I would have."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm still unsure whether you plann..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm still unsure whether you planned the attack. I wanted to see how you'd react when I accused you."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It is, isn't it?""
entries.dialogueText: "It is, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I trust our troops will obey him t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust our troops will obey him this time around."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""This will be nothing like the last..."
entries.dialogueText: "This will be nothing like the last war, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All the help in the world won't ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "All the help in the world won't matter with a subpar military."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We could be more prepared, it's tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could be more prepared, it's true. But if we get creative, we can still win this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We don't need his help. Look at ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't need his help. Look at how strong our military is now."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As long as Lespian interference is..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as Lespian interference is a possibility, we need all the help we can get."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come on. There must be some part o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on. There must be some part of you that's excited by the idea of crushing the Palesians to a pulp."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She blushed slightly."
entries.dialogueText: She blushed slightly.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Well... maybe a little bit.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well... maybe a little bit."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who are these people?""
entries.dialogueText: "Who are these people?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Close friends of House Azaro. We'v..."
entries.dialogueText: "Close friends of House Azaro. We've been using this building as member's club since Rizia took back the Pales Administrative District."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Will he be fit enough to resume hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Will he be fit enough to resume his old position?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shrugged."
entries.dialogueText: She shrugged.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Time will tell. At the very least,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Time will tell. At the very least, he'll be able to help with behind-the-scenes strategizing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you sure about that? Because t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure about that? Because the border investigation results seemed to imply otherwise."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty, I...""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We took our beverages and raised th..."
entries.dialogueText: We took our beverages and raised them.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To House Azaro.""
entries.dialogueText: "To House Azaro."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To victory.""
entries.dialogueText: "To victory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To peace.""
entries.dialogueText: "To peace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A proso.""
entries.dialogueText: "A proso."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To us.""
entries.dialogueText: "To us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked me in the eye as our gla..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked me in the eye as our glasses clinked.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""To victory.""
entries.dialogueText: "To victory."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked me in the eye as our gla..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked me in the eye as our glasses clinked.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""To us.""
entries.dialogueText: "To us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked me in the eye as our gla..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked me in the eye as our glasses clinked.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""To House Toras.""
entries.dialogueText: "To House Toras."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked me in the eye as our gla..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked me in the eye as our glasses clinked.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""To peace.""
entries.dialogueText: "To peace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked me in the eye as our gla..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked me in the eye as our glasses clinked.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""To the King's good health.""
entries.dialogueText: "To the King's good health."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me as if I'd grown a..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me as if I'd grown a second head.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He's been out of commission for to..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's been out of commission for too long."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I wanted to tell you something whi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wanted to tell you something while we were here."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""My house has begun to complain to..."
entries.dialogueText: "My house has begun to complain to me about the way you've been running the country."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Everyone's a critic. Why should I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everyone's a critic. Why should I care?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell them to take it up with my co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell them to take it up with my complaint department. It's in the Citadel prison."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have three royal houses to cater..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have three royal houses to cater to, on top of the Rizian public. It can't be all Azaros, all the time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Azaros are turning against me?..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Azaros are turning against me? That's not good."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We'll have a hell of a hard time w..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll have a hell of a hard time winning the war if we can't marshall support from my family."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""This is rather serious, I'm afraid.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is rather serious, I'm afraid."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Where do I start?""
entries.dialogueText: "Where do I start?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She had a skeptical look in her eye..."
entries.dialogueText: She had a skeptical look in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We could've taken the whole field..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could've taken the whole field if we wanted. Our military's the strongest it's been in years."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We could've taken the whole field..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could've taken the whole field without a struggle. If we'd invested more in the military, I mean."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She paused in contemplation."
entries.dialogueText: She paused in contemplation.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A strong military is like a theate..."
entries.dialogueText: "A strong military is like a theater costume. You want to have it for the show, but it's ridiculous to use it in real life."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As long as Lespia's lurking about,..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as Lespia's lurking about, we would have lost again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I took the throne with the aim of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I took the throne with the aim of avoiding conflict. I am proud to have stayed the course."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm a lover, not a fighter.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm a lover, not a fighter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I love a good battle as much as th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I love a good battle as much as the next chap. But I didn't want to risk further jeopardizing the return of Zille."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gave my a sly smile."
entries.dialogueText: She gave my a sly smile.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""What's love without a little friss..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's love without a little frisson?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Defeating Pales would've sent Smol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Defeating Pales would've sent Smolak a strong message about how Rizia deals with misbehaving neighbors."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Courses change. You couldn't have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Courses change. You couldn't have known what Pales was about to do."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Maybe. We'll never know.""
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe. We'll never know."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our generals don't feel that way.""
entries.dialogueText: "Our generals don't feel that way."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But you're right. My family may ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you're right. My family may have wanted another war with the Grand Duchy, but not me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Admit it. Some part of you was exc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Admit it. Some part of you was excited by the idea of crushing Pales to a pulp."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And how is House Azaro feeling abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "And how is House Azaro feeling about the fact that we aren't at war right now?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank God I have such a sensible w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank God I have such a sensible war councilor."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Actually, Your Majesty, they--""
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, Your Majesty, they--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her brow furrowed."
entries.dialogueText: Her brow furrowed.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I still think avoiding conflict wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still think avoiding conflict with Pales was the correct strategy. Of course, not everyone in Rizia feels the same way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're my war councilor. And you t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're my war councilor. And you truly didn't want us to go to war?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who dares disagree with my diploma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who dares disagree with my diplomatic strategy? Tell me, and I'll have their heads."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My uncle will get over it.""
entries.dialogueText: "My uncle will get over it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Making unpopular decisions is part..."
entries.dialogueText: "Making unpopular decisions is part and parcel of being king. I've learned not to let it affect me."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It's a lot of heads, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's a lot of heads, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I do appreciate the investments yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do appreciate the investments you've made in our military. But it made no sense to waste them on this."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Given our lack of investment in th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given our lack of investment in the military, our showing would've been quite poor. Better to play it safe than risk losing even more of the country."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I don't only mean him.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't only mean him."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I hate to say it, but too many unp..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hate to say it, but too many unpopular decisions *will* affect you."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""They are not asking for special pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are not asking for special privileges. Only for acknowledgement."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You understand, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "You understand, then."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I've heard rumors of your plans to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard rumors of your plans to change the Rizian government. They won't make it off the ground without my family's support."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""House Azaro controls the military..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Azaro controls the military as well as much of Rizia's industrial production. You don't want Cardesse-Montaklar on your bad side."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked me in the eye."
entries.dialogueText: She looked me in the eye.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I am innocent, Your Majesty. But I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am innocent, Your Majesty. But I recognize that turning me in would have been the easiest thing to do."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""How romantic of you.""
entries.dialogueText: "How romantic of you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her face grew troubled."
entries.dialogueText: Her face grew troubled.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I didn't start anything.""
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't start anything."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A look of confusion spread across h..."
entries.dialogueText: A look of confusion spread across her face.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I hope you're satisfied with my re..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you're satisfied with my reaction."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I have tried to justify your actio..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have tried to justify your actions to the others. But there's only so much I can explain away."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I shouldn't be blathering on like..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shouldn't be blathering on like this on the eve of a war."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Simply put, Your Majesty, my famil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Simply put, Your Majesty, my family likes order."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook her head."
entries.dialogueText: She shook her head.

entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""So there are some who see your rat..."
entries.dialogueText: "So there are some who see your rather relaxed attitude towards our kingdom's national security as a direct affront."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "And I've heard worries that the public's declining opinion of you may result in instability on a mass scale."

entries.dialogueText: "While we're here, I wanted to thank you for everything you've done for House Azaro over the past years."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've been following my own instinc..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been following my own instincts. If those happen to align with House Azaro's interests, so much the better."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, thanks to House Azaro for no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, thanks to House Azaro for not usurping me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I need your family's support. Espe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need your family's support. Especially with war in the cards."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No need to thank me. Your house an..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need to thank me. Your house and mine share a special bond."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pleasing your family isn't as impo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pleasing your family isn't as important to me as pleasing you."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That's very sweet. I congratulate..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's very sweet. I congratulate you on managing both."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You've managed one of those. The s..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've managed one of those. The second will surely follow."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""So far, they do.""
entries.dialogueText: "So far, they do."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Not every king would see the wisdo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not every king would see the wisdom in honoring it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Ha. You don't need to worry about..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ha. You don't need to worry about that."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""War is a terrible thing. It's not..."
entries.dialogueText: "War is a terrible thing. It's not a decision to be made lightly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I felt her foot brush against mine..."
entries.dialogueText: I felt her foot brush against mine under the table.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Thankfully, you have it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thankfully, you have it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I confess there are a few holdouts..."
entries.dialogueText: "I confess there are a few holdouts who wish the Pales gas dispute had ended with an annexation."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She made a face."
entries.dialogueText: She made a face.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But your commitment to our kingdom..."
entries.dialogueText: "But your commitment to our kingdom's national defense has reassured them that Rizia will be ready for the next war, if and when it ever comes."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I personally wish you had made a l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I personally wish you had made a larger commitment to Rizia's national defense than your predecessor. But there's still time."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your readiness to defend Rizia aga..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your readiness to defend Rizia against Palesian aggression won you many admirers in Cardesse-Montaklar."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes, there are those of us who wis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, there are those of us who wish you had done more to prepare our kingdom for the war we now find ourselves facing."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As did the steps you took to prepa..."
entries.dialogueText: "As did the steps you took to prepare our kingdom for the war we now find ourselves facing."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But your commitment to maintaining..."
entries.dialogueText: "But your commitment to maintaining our internal security even in the midst of an international crisis is very reassuring."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your commitment to maintaining our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your commitment to maintaining our internal security even in the midst of an international crisis has been impressive."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Even discounting the opinion of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even discounting the opinion of those who believe the Pales gas dispute should have ended in an annexation..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes, the hawks in my house are hap..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, the hawks in my house are happy enough with your decision to invade Pales. However..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Cardesse-Montaklar is troubled by..."
entries.dialogueText: "Cardesse-Montaklar is troubled by how little you did to prepare our kingdom for the war we now find ourselves facing."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The fact that you have invested so..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fact that you have invested so little in the Rizian military is proof, to some, that you don't take House Azaro's concerns seriously."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And I've heard worries that the st..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I've heard worries that the steps you've taken to democratize Rizia, however well-intentioned, might lead to instability."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What about you, Duchess? Do you sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about you, Duchess? Do you share that criticism?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell the whiners within your house..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell the whiners within your house that the King of Rizia does not tolerate insubordination."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm doing everything I can. I'd li..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm doing everything I can. I'd like to see any one of your relatives try ruling the country."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Be careful what you wish for.""
entries.dialogueText: "Be careful what you wish for."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As a councilor. I'm duty-bound to..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a councilor. I'm duty-bound to support my king."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I can always advise you from the s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can always advise you from the sidelines."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But as your lover, I hope I'm allo..."
entries.dialogueText: "But as your lover, I hope I'm allowed to hold you to account."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Democratizing Rizia will lead to a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Democratizing Rizia will lead to a happier population, which will stabilize the country in the long run."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled wryly."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled wryly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She frowned."
entries.dialogueText: She frowned.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""To an extent, perhaps. But my hous..."
entries.dialogueText: "To an extent, perhaps. But my house will never agree to give the people unchecked power."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And I've heard worries that the ra..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I've heard worries that the rather Malenyevist posturing you've adopted during your reign will lead to instability on a mass scale."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That's the attitude they'd like to..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's the attitude they'd like to see more of."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I believe in order, too. But maint..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe in order, too. But maintaining it requires a light touch, not an iron fist."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'll try to communicate that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll try to communicate that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Malenyevist? I'm only working to i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Malenyevist? I'm only working to improve public welfare, which will stabilize the country in the long run."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She frowned."
entries.dialogueText: She frowned.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""To an extent, perhaps. But my hous..."
entries.dialogueText: "To an extent, perhaps. But my house will never agree to empower the working class at the expense of the nobility."

entries.dialogueText: "The feeling may not be mutual."

entries.dialogueText: "That's amazing news! I'm looking forward to working with him."

entries.dialogueText: "If he goes against me, he'll be punished. It's as simple as that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I'll reason with him. Man to man."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I wish you luck with that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wish you luck with that."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: I reached for the glass on the table and took a sip.

entries.dialogueText: "Thanks, but I'd rather not stay. We should be headed back to the base."

entries.dialogueText: It was a smooth, tangy mix of dark rum and orange blossom water with a squeeze of pomegranate syrup.

entries.dialogueText: The water was lightly fizzy, with an aftertaste of lemon.

entries.dialogueText: It was a warming mix of imported Sordish whiskey, honey, cinnamon and cloves.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: It was a warming mix of local whiskey, honey, cinnamon and cloves.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's worth falling off the wagon..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's worth falling off the wagon for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Liquid courage. Just what I needed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Liquid courage. Just what I needed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She raised an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: She raised an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Excuse me?""
entries.dialogueText: "Excuse me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you're right about your house's..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you're right about your house's attitude towards me, it's dangerous for us to stay connected."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All this sneaking around isn't for..."
entries.dialogueText: "All this sneaking around isn't for me. I want someone I can be with in the open."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Because of the investigation. If a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because of the investigation. If anyone finds out I refused to turn you in while I was romantically involved with you, I could be in even worse trouble than I am now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I should have gotten something str..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should have gotten something stronger."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for the company. I'm rea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for the company. I'm ready to leave now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm going to regret ordering this..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to regret ordering this tomorrow."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""For the war?""
entries.dialogueText: "For the war?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""For the gas deal signing?""
entries.dialogueText: "For the gas deal signing?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Here's something you won't regret.""
entries.dialogueText: "Here's something you won't regret."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She leaned across the table and kis..."
entries.dialogueText: She leaned across the table and kissed me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For this.""
entries.dialogueText: "For this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I leaned across the table and kisse..."
entries.dialogueText: I leaned across the table and kissed her.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To placate your angry relatives.""
entries.dialogueText: "To placate your angry relatives."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed. This will be the ultimate..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. This will be the ultimate challenge of my reign."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To face another day.""
entries.dialogueText: "To face another day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Courage is always useful. It doesn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Courage is always useful. It doesn't matter what it's for."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""For what?""
entries.dialogueText: "For what?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed. It will be a landmark mome..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. It will be a landmark moment in my reign."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: She frowned for a second, then brightened up.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
