entries.dialogueText: "I suppose that's sensible. Titus has been waiting long enough."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I feel so refreshed.""
entries.dialogueText: "I feel so refreshed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her fingers grazed my lips as we sl..."
entries.dialogueText: Her fingers grazed my lips as we slowly drew apart. If the other bar patrons noticed anything, they didn't show it.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Not to be presumptuous, but I have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to be presumptuous, but I have a pass to the VIP suite. And I happen to know it isn't occupied."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If it's refreshing you want...""
entries.dialogueText: "If it's refreshing you want..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would prefer to keep things betw..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would prefer to keep things between us professional. You understand."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have known true love. And it's n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have known true love. And it's not what I feel when I'm with you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It wouldn't be fair to you. I doub..."
entries.dialogueText: "It wouldn't be fair to you. I doubt I'm even capable of loving a woman."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Of loving a *woman*...""
entries.dialogueText: "Of loving a *woman*..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She quickly shook off her look of s..."
entries.dialogueText: She quickly shook off her look of suspicion.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""A union between the King and the h..."
entries.dialogueText: "A union between the King and the heir to House Azaro could be advantageous beyond measure."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Oh.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took a large sip from her glass..."
entries.dialogueText: She took a large sip from her glass.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We don't have to be in love for th..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't have to be in love for this to work, you know."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We don't have to worry about being..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't have to worry about being colleagues once I'm off the council."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her face fell."
entries.dialogueText: Her face fell.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Being with me will help your relat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Being with me will help your relations with House Azaro in the long run. We just need to wait until I'm off the council."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We can be together. We just have t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can be together. We just have to wait until I'm off the council."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wouldn't be able to wait until t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't be able to wait until then. I can't control myself around you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry, Lucita. It's not going to h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, Lucita. It's not going to happen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry, Lucita. It's over.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, Lucita. It's over."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She lowered her eyes."
entries.dialogueText: She lowered her eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've been trying to get closer t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've been trying to get closer to the throne since the day we met. It's not hard to discern your true motivations."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Then we'll always have Qalus.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then we'll always have Qalus."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes flashed in outrage. She re..."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes flashed in outrage. She responded in an even tone.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Internally, our national security..."
entries.dialogueText: "Internally, our national security is not all that it could be. But it's not too late for something to be done about it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Simply put, my family likes order...."
entries.dialogueText: "Simply put, my family likes order. And they like monarchs who are invested in maintaining it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And how do they plan to reward me?""
entries.dialogueText: "And how do they plan to reward me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sounds like I should have been bor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds like I should have been born an Azaro."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Shouldn't royal unity be its own r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Shouldn't royal unity be its own reward?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Obviously, you can count on the Az..."
entries.dialogueText: "Obviously, you can count on the Azaros' full support in the war."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I've heard rumors that you're tryi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard rumors that you're trying to make changes to the Rizian government. I believe my family could be convinced to back you, as long as you don't go too far."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you mean, too far?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean, too far?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't. Incremental change is goo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't. Incremental change is good for us all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Going too far is the point of my r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Going too far is the point of my reforms. The old system must die for a new one to be reborn."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We should revisit the subject once..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should revisit the subject once my father's recovered enough. I know General Taddeus would be eager to make Ana Azaro's dream a reality."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smirked."
entries.dialogueText: She smirked.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""No looking back, Your Majesty. Onl..."
entries.dialogueText: "No looking back, Your Majesty. Only forward."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Ready to face the next challenge.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ready to face the next challenge."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled slyly."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled slyly.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Perhaps one day you'll join the fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps one day you'll join the family."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You flatter me, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "You flatter me, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Great. Because I've got more inves..."
entries.dialogueText: "Great. Because I've got more investments planned."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I look forward to them.""
entries.dialogueText: "I look forward to them."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Giving the citizenry a modicum of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Giving the citizenry a modicum of power can help prevent another uprising. Giving them too much will lead to instability on a mass scale."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That's how I see it as well. Givin..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's how I see it as well. Giving the citizenry too much power at once will result in instability on a mass scale."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""By 'the old system', do you mean y..."
entries.dialogueText: "By 'the old system', do you mean you and I? Because we'll be the ones on the chopping block if the citizenry is granted too much power."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Strong bonds between the Crown and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Strong bonds between the Crown and the military have always served this country well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took a sip of her drink and lig..."
entries.dialogueText: She took a sip of her drink and lightly touched my shoulder.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can, and it chills me to the bon..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can, and it chills me to the bone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Truly the best of both worlds.""
entries.dialogueText: "Truly the best of both worlds."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's only one way a regime like..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's only one way a regime like that can end. With the king's beheading."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's better than a king with absol..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's better than a king with absolute power."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm intrigued. Tell me more.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm intrigued. Tell me more."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""She never got the chance to go int..."
entries.dialogueText: "She never got the chance to go into detail. But it wouldn't be impossible today."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The monarch gets to make the popul..."
entries.dialogueText: "The monarch gets to make the popular decisions while the military does the dirty work. Not a bad balance."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Military officers are willing to d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Military officers are willing to die for their country. Why shouldn't they get a chance to rule it?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Not if he and the military work to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not if he and the military work together. As a single, well-oiled machine."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We'll never know whether it would..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll never know whether it would have worked. But I do see potential in the idea."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But I'm getting ahead of myself. O..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I'm getting ahead of myself. Our main focus should be on winning the war. We can revisit this idea later, once my father's well enough to discuss it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm relieved his recovery is proce..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm relieved his recovery is proceeding on course. It'll be a pleasure to work with him again."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The feeling is mutual, I'm sure.""
entries.dialogueText: "The feeling is mutual, I'm sure."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm relieved his recovery is proce..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm relieved his recovery is proceeding on course. It'll be a pleasure to work with him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That old dinosaur will be more of..."
entries.dialogueText: "That old dinosaur will be more of a hindrance than a help."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Even incapacitated, he's one of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even incapacitated, he's one of the sharpest minds in the country."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm looking forward to finally spe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm looking forward to finally speaking with the General again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've heard enough, thanks. Our mil..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard enough, thanks. Our military is powerful enough as it is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Pales campaign will be the ult..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Pales campaign will be the ultimate test of the military's mettle. If our generals succeed, they'll have earned the right to rule by my side."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Confidentially, I feel the same wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Confidentially, I feel the same way about the House of Delegates. They're a waste of money and a blight on my authority as King."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Agreed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As you wish. I won't bring it up a..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish. I won't bring it up again."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He's looking forward to speaking w..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's looking forward to speaking with you as well. About a great many things."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook her head."
entries.dialogueText: She shook her head.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""What am I even doing, bringing all..."
entries.dialogueText: "What am I even doing, bringing all this up? We're here to relax."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Just one.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just one."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She blinked."
entries.dialogueText: She blinked.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Don't worry about the drinks, by t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry about the drinks, by the way. They're on the house."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You read my mind.""
entries.dialogueText: "You read my mind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's in the VIP suite?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's in the VIP suite?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Everything a king and his trusted..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything a king and his trusted councilor would need for a deep, stimulating strategizing session."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We shouldn't keep Titus waiting.""
entries.dialogueText: "We shouldn't keep Titus waiting."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She winked at me and slipped out of..."
entries.dialogueText: She winked at me and slipped out of the booth.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It's literally his job.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's literally his job."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. Lead the way, milady.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Lead the way, milady."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You thought ahead. How suite of yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You thought ahead. How suite of you."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our troops will be with you every..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our troops will be with you every step of the way. And so will I."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I didn't know you were on it, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't know you were on it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I suppose that's sensible. We woul..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose that's sensible. We wouldn't want to get drunk on the eve of declaring war."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If it's something strong you want...."
entries.dialogueText: "If it's something strong you want..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Forget the drink, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "Forget the drink, then."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Peace between Rizia and Pales, and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Peace between Rizia and Pales, and not a single drop of blood shed. Who would have thought."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You'll have my help with that. No..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll have my help with that. No alcohol necessary."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Courage alone is useless without p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Courage alone is useless without planning and strength behind it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You don't need alcohol for that. R..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't need alcohol for that. Remember, Your Majesty, you're not alone."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I hope you don't feel pressure to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you don't feel pressure to drink with me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I might as well. Tonight could be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I might as well. Tonight could be our last night together."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Then let's make it count.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then let's make it count."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You know... tonight could be our l..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know... tonight could be our last night together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you know that buying me a d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you know that buying me a drink doesn't entitle you or any other Azaro to special favors from me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for bringing me here. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for bringing me here. I didn't know how much I needed a moment of respite."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The next time we come here, that b..."
entries.dialogueText: "The next time we come here, that border over there won't exist."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I might as well. Who knows what wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I might as well. Who knows what will happen tomorrow?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for bringing me here. Da..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for bringing me here. Dare I say my spirits have been lifted?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For the pleasure of your company,..."
entries.dialogueText: "For the pleasure of your company, Duchess, I would fall off a thousand wagons."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Who says I'm buying?""
entries.dialogueText: "Who says I'm buying?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Once a party prince, always a part..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once a party prince, always a party prince. No use in denying it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She laughed, then quickly assumed a..."
entries.dialogueText: She laughed, then quickly assumed a more solemn expression.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm grateful for the audience with..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm grateful for the audience with you, Your Majesty. You aren't obligated to act on anything I said."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You, pressuring me? The very idea..."
entries.dialogueText: "You, pressuring me? The very idea is ludicrous."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I love that I can speak with you s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I love that I can speak with you so openly. I'd love it even more if we found a more intimate venue to continue this conversation."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She flashed me a knowing smile."
entries.dialogueText: She flashed me a knowing smile.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We'll replace it with a monument...."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll replace it with a monument. To the lives we had to take to defend our sovereignty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Funny, Your Majesty. But you're we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Funny, Your Majesty. But you're welcome."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Sometimes a bird's-eye perspective..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sometimes a bird's-eye perspective is all it takes to achieve clarity."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We finished our drinks as the city..."
entries.dialogueText: We finished our drinks as the city lights twinkled below us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All too soon, it was time to rejoin..."
entries.dialogueText: All too soon, it was time to rejoin Titus and begin the trip back to the air force base.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We finished our drinks as the city..."
entries.dialogueText: We finished our drinks as the city lights twinkled below us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once we were done, we rejoined Titu..."
entries.dialogueText: Once we were done, we rejoined Titus to begin the trip back to the air force base.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She blushed and lowered her eyes."
entries.dialogueText: She blushed and lowered her eyes.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We should get back to the base. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should get back to the base. We wouldn't want to keep Titus waiting."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Leaving my unfinished drink on the..."
entries.dialogueText: Leaving my unfinished drink on the table, I followed her to the elevator.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The drinks are on you tonight, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "The drinks are on you tonight, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I truly apologize if I gave you th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I truly apologize if I gave you that impression."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But I understand how committed you..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I understand how committed you are to keeping the Toras crown. Much like your father before you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She slipped out of the booth."
entries.dialogueText: She slipped out of the booth.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She downed the rest of her beverage..."
entries.dialogueText: She downed the rest of her beverage in one go and hurriedly made her way to the elevator.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She groaned and swatted my arm."
entries.dialogueText: She groaned and swatted my arm.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Is it too late to rescind my invit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is it too late to rescind my invitation?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fornication before marriage is a s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fornication before marriage is a sin in the eyes of St. Wruhec."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes widened. She cautiously la..."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes widened. She cautiously laughed.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm sorry if you got the wrong ide..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry if you got the wrong idea, Your Majesty. I want to keep talking with you. That's all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No... not tonight. We have all the..."
entries.dialogueText: "No... not tonight. We have all the time in the world."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You're an open book, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're an open book, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She slipped out of the booth."
entries.dialogueText: She slipped out of the booth.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Don't worry about paying for the d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry about paying for the drinks. They're on the house."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a wink, she headed past the ba..."
entries.dialogueText: With a wink, she headed past the bar down a darkened corridor. Leaving my unfinished drink on the table, I followed close behind.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She sighed."
entries.dialogueText: She sighed.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Then we had better get a move on.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then we had better get a move on."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita and I had just concluded our..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita and I had just concluded our visit to Terador Air Force Base.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The base's new expansion was truly..."
entries.dialogueText: The base's new expansion was truly impressive.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Construction on the expansion I'd o..."
entries.dialogueText: Construction on the expansion I'd ordered was still in progress. I knew that once it was complete, it would be truly impressive.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The focus I'd devoted to the Rizian..."
entries.dialogueText: The focus I'd devoted to the Rizian air force early in my reign was paying off. There were more officers and airplanes here than I'd ever seen before.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The top cadet gave us a demonstrati..."
entries.dialogueText: The top cadet gave us a demonstration of one of the new planes from Morella. Its speed and maneuverability put Rizian aircraft to shame.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Amid the whirlwind of activity, we..."
entries.dialogueText: Amid the whirlwind of activity, we barely got a chance to speak to each other, let alone discuss the fallout of the border investigation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the way back to the motorcade, s..."
entries.dialogueText: On the way back to the motorcade, she asked me to accompany her downtown.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Amid the whirlwind of activity, we..."
entries.dialogueText: Amid the whirlwind of activity, we barely got a chance to speak to each other.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We're making our official declarat..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're making our official declaration soon, aren't we? No going back from that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know you never wanted war. That'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you never wanted war. That's why I defended you against the investigation committee's accusations."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A smile of gratitude blossomed on h..."
entries.dialogueText: A smile of gratitude blossomed on her face.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I didn't plan the border attack, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't plan the border attack, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But if you think I did, why didn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if you think I did, why didn't you arrest me?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty, I haven't had the ch..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I haven't had the chance to thank you for not giving in to Duke Reinhart's demands for my arrest."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Needless to say, the idea that I w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Needless to say, the idea that I would have planned such a sloppy false flag operation is preposterous."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Unless... you were deliberately be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unless... you were deliberately being sloppy so that when the investigation revealed it was you, I wouldn't believe it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alvarez must have really gone back..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alvarez must have really gone back to the bottle if he thought that'd work on me."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It worked on Duke Reinhart.""
entries.dialogueText: "It worked on Duke Reinhart."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She made a scoffing noise."
entries.dialogueText: She made a scoffing noise.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't believe Duke Reinhart thou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe Duke Reinhart thought I would turn you in and go back to our gas deal as if nothing had happened."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I wonder if he would do the same w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wonder if he would do the same were it one of his councilors under investigation."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But I recognize that turning me in..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I recognize that turning me in would have been the easiest thing to do."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I do recognize that turning me in..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do recognize that turning me in would have been the easiest thing to do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I never thought you were guilty. M..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never thought you were guilty. Mr. Esquibel had his suspicions."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Did he? Hmm.""
entries.dialogueText: "Did he? Hmm."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It's the Duchess of Montaklar's wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's the Duchess of Montaklar's word against some anonymous commanding officer's, and I'm the one they blame? Unbelievable."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled warmly."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled warmly.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm glad there's one man who saw t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad there's one man who saw through it all."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You have my gratitude. And that of..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have my gratitude. And that of my family."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She raised her glass. I did the sam..."
entries.dialogueText: She raised her glass. I did the same.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""So you have my gratitude. And that..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you have my gratitude. And that of my family."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Still holding my gaze, she took a s..."
entries.dialogueText: Still holding my gaze, she took a slow, reflective sip.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I will confess one thing to you, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will confess one thing to you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Before this investigation business..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before this investigation business, my house was complaining to me about the way you've been running the country."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And I'm still not sure that your e..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I'm still not sure that your exoneration of me has completely satisfied them."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""My exoneration aside, I hope you k..."
entries.dialogueText: "My exoneration aside, I hope you know how much House Azaro appreciates everything you've done for them."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You're right. We'd have to be idio..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. We'd have to be idiots to keep seeing each other after this, even in private."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Well. We'll always have Qalus.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well. We'll always have Qalus."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Don't worry about the drinks tonig..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry about the drinks tonight, Your Majesty. They're on the house."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""His Majesty Valero told me he trus..."
entries.dialogueText: "His Majesty Valero told me he trusted General Taddeus with his life. Treat our house well, and he will be your fiercest protector."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Remind me. When did you last speak..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remind me. When did you last speak to King Valero?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Tragically enough, on the day he d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tragically enough, on the day he died."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Aside from yourself, you mean.""
entries.dialogueText: "Aside from yourself, you mean."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And if I *don't* treat your house..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if I *don't* treat your house well?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That should be obvious by now.""
entries.dialogueText: "That should be obvious by now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My problems are too complex for a..."
entries.dialogueText: "My problems are too complex for a swordsman to solve."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He shoots guns, too. Don't forget..."
entries.dialogueText: "He shoots guns, too. Don't forget about that."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I was at the Palace for an intervi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was at the Palace for an interview with Hugo. Your father signed the order for me to become interim war councilor."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Truth be told, we barely conversed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Truth be told, we barely conversed. He was clearly preoccupied with other matters."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Should he rejoin the council, I wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should he rejoin the council, I will welcome him back with open arms."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm glad.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Representation is important. But w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Representation is important. But with the heads of our provincial armies on hand to advise you, the Delegates will be irrelevant."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We Azaros put a lot of work into t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We Azaros put a lot of work into training our provincial forces. You can imagine the uproar when they were placed under Crown control."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Camp Domus drills loyalty to the C..."
entries.dialogueText: "Camp Domus drills loyalty to the Crown into its soldiers from day one of basic training. Your 'pledge of allegiance' decree struck the commanders there as a sign you don't trust them."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Since it's just the two of us here..."
entries.dialogueText: "Since it's just the two of us here, let me tell you something."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""During the War of Rizian Successio..."
entries.dialogueText: "During the War of Rizian Succession, my ancestor Ana drew up plans for a monarcho-military system of government. Rizia, ruled by both a king and the army... can you imagine?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Needless to say, my father is very..."
entries.dialogueText: "Needless to say, my father is very much looking forward to serving at your side."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm relieved his recovery is proce..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm relieved his recovery is proceeding on course. It'll be a pleasure to work with him again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm relieved his recovery is proce..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm relieved his recovery is proceeding on course. It'll be a pleasure to work with him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I couldn't imagine retaking Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't imagine retaking Pales without him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And you're sure he's sharp enough..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you're sure he's sharp enough to lead our armies?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""His body may be incapacitated, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "His body may be incapacitated, but his mind is certainly not."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Neither can I.""
entries.dialogueText: "Neither can I."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But of course, you have the power..."
entries.dialogueText: "But of course, you have the power to issue your own commands as you see fit."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I must say I've grown fond of havi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must say I've grown fond of having you on the Council. I'd prefer it if he doesn't replace you just yet."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It will still be a while, as you'v..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will still be a while, as you've seen. But even incapacitated, he's got one of the sharpest minds in the country."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The feeling is mutual. As long as..."
entries.dialogueText: "The feeling is mutual. As long as he doesn't start any more wars."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes narrowed."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes narrowed.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your father wanted to retake Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your father wanted to retake Pales as much as mine did. Possibly more so."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Treat our house well, and Father -..."
entries.dialogueText: "Treat our house well, and Father -- General Taddeus -- will be your fiercest protector, as he was King Valero's."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Of course, we'd need a strong mili..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, we'd need a strong military. And you'd have to get rid of the House of Delegates, but I always found them rather silly anyway..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""In any case, I'm looking forward t..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any case, I'm looking forward to having Father back at full strength."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""In any case, I'm looking forward t..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any case, I'm looking forward to having Father back at full strength."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Do me a favor and forget that comm..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do me a favor and forget that comment I made about Ana Azaro's plans, God rest her soul."
